test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: Price is the monetery vallue placed on a product.
Price is the monitary value placed on a product.
Price is the monetary value placed on a product.
Price is the monetary value plased on a product.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Price is the monetary value placed on a product'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Let's check all the options carefully;

__
 
• **Option 1**: In this sentence the wrongly spelled words are** 'monetery' **(the correct spelling is **'monetary'**) and **'vallue' **(the correct spelling is** 'value'**).
 
• **Option 2**: In this sentence the wrongly spelled word is** 'monitary'** (the correct spelling is **'monetary'**).
 
• **Option 3**: In this sentence, there is **no spelling error**.
 
• **Option 4**: In this sentence the wrongly spelled word is** 'plased' **(the correct spelling is **'placed'**)
 
• So, now it is clear that among these options only the sentence in Option 4 has no spelling error.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Price is the monetary value placed on a product'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of **monetary** is related to money or currency. (आर्थिक)

 
 
• **For Example** - The **monetary** policies of RBI have been changed.
